design_target: Modern competitive rogue archetype built around alternating two Field Spells.

cards.name: Mendiwake Mari, Lady Between Peaks
cards.role: Primary one-card starter and grind-piece recycler
cards.text: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can apply 1 of these effects. ● Activate 1 "Mendiwake" Field Spell directly from your Deck. ● Add 1 "Mendiwake" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Mendiwake Mari, Lady Between Peaks". If a face-up card in a Field Zone leaves the field while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; add 1 "Mendiwake" Spell/Trap from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Mendiwake Mari, Lady Between Peaks" once per turn.

cards.name: Mendiwake Sugaar, Thunder-Coiled Consort
cards.role: Fusion material, extender and proactive removal
cards.text: If a Field Spell is face-up on the field, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Mendiwake Sugaar, Thunder-Coiled Consort" once per turn this way. If this card is Special Summoned: You can send 1 "Mendiwake" card from your Deck to the GY, except "Mendiwake Sugaar, Thunder-Coiled Consort". If this card is sent to the GY as Fusion Material for a "Mendiwake" monster: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it. You can only use each effect of "Mendiwake Sugaar, Thunder-Coiled Consort" once per turn.

cards.name: Mendiwake Basajaun, Shepherd of the Deep Wood
cards.role: Secondary starter, setup tool and field-change extender
cards.text: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can apply the appropriate effect, based on whether a Field Spell is face-up on the field. ● No: Activate 1 "Mendiwake" Field Spell directly from your Deck. ● Yes: Send 1 "Mendiwake" monster from your Deck to the GY, except "Mendiwake Basajaun, Shepherd of the Deep Wood". If a face-up card in a Field Zone leaves the field: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower "Mendiwake" monster in your GY, except this card; Special Summon it in Defense Position, but negate its effects. You can only use each effect of "Mendiwake Basajaun, Shepherd of the Deep Wood" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate either of this card's effects, except "Mendiwake" monsters.

cards.name: Mendiwake Basandere, Keeper of First Seeds
cards.role: Field Spell access and self-replacing extender
cards.text: You can discard this card; add 1 "Mendiwake" Field Spell from your Deck to your hand. If a face-up card in a Field Zone leaves the field while this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Mendiwake Basandere, Keeper of First Seeds" once per turn. You cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate either of this card's effects, except "Mendiwake" monsters.

cards.name: Mendiwake Tartalo, One-Eyed Stone-Herder
cards.role: Field-trigger enabler and non-destruction board breaker
cards.text: You can target 1 face-up "Mendiwake" Field Spell you control; return it to the hand, and if you do, Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned, and a face-up card in a Field Zone left the field this turn: You can target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; return it to the hand. You can only use each effect of "Mendiwake Tartalo, One-Eyed Stone-Herder" once per turn.

cards.name: Mendiwake Lamia, Comb of the Hidden River
cards.text: If a Field Spell is face-up on the field, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Mendiwake Lamia, Comb of the Hidden River" once per turn this way. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 of your "Mendiwake" Spell/Traps that is banished or in your GY; Set it, but banish it when it leaves the field. If a face-up card in a Field Zone leaves the field while this card is face-up: You can draw 1 card, then place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck. You can only use each effect of "Mendiwake Lamia, Comb of the Hidden River" once per turn.

cards.name: Mendiwake Jentil, Bearer of the Last Dolmen
cards.role: Large recurring extender and monster-effect suppression
cards.text: If a face-up card in a Field Zone leaves the field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand or GY. You can only use this effect of "Mendiwake Jentil, Bearer of the Last Dolmen" once per turn. While a Field Spell is face-up on the field, your opponent cannot target other "Mendiwake" monsters you control with card effects. (Quick Effect): You can send 1 other "Mendiwake" card from your hand or field to the GY, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; negate its effects until the end of this turn, and if you do, it loses 1000 ATK. You can only use this effect of "Mendiwake Jentil, Bearer of the Last Dolmen" once per turn.

cards.name: Mendiwake Gaueko, Master of the Path After Dark
cards.role: Archetypal hand interaction and graveyard pressure
cards.text: When your opponent activates a monster effect while a Field Spell is face-up on the field (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, change that opponent's monster to face-down Defense Position. If a face-up card in a Field Zone leaves the field while this card is face-up: You can banish 1 card from your opponent's GY, face-down. You can only use each effect of "Mendiwake Gaueko, Master of the Path After Dark" once per turn.

cards.name: Mendiwake Mari and Sugaar—Storm Between Mountains
cards.role: Primary Extra Deck boss, Field switcher and omni-negate
cards.text:
"Mendiwake Mari, Lady Between Peaks" + "Mendiwake Sugaar, Thunder-Coiled Consort"
If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can activate 1 "Mendiwake" Field Spell from your Deck or GY. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can send 1 face-up Field Spell you control to the GY; negate the activation, and if you do, banish that card, then you can activate 1 "Mendiwake" Field Spell with a different name from your Deck or GY. If this Fusion Summoned card in its owner's control leaves the field because of an opponent's card: You can Special Summon 1 "Mendiwake Mari, Lady Between Peaks" and 1 "Mendiwake Sugaar, Thunder-Coiled Consort" from your GY and/or banishment, but negate their effects. You can only use each effect of "Mendiwake Mari and Sugaar—Storm Between Mountains" once per turn.

cards.name: Mendiwake Anboto—Cave of Red Storms
cards.role: Aggressive Field, graveyard setup and Special Summon engine
cards.text: When this card is activated: You can send 1 "Mendiwake" monster from your Deck to the GY. All "Mendiwake" monsters you control gain 300 ATK. During your Main Phase: You can target 1 "Mendiwake" monster in your GY; send this face-up card to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon that target, then you can activate 1 "Mendiwake Txindoki—Cave of White Mist" directly from your Deck or GY. You can only use each effect of "Mendiwake Anboto—Cave of Red Storms" once per turn. You can only activate 1 "Mendiwake Anboto—Cave of Red Storms" per turn.

cards.name: Mendiwake Txindoki—Cave of White Mist
cards.role: Defensive Field, interaction searcher and resource recycler
cards.text: When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Mendiwake" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, except "Mendiwake Txindoki—Cave of White Mist". The first time each "Mendiwake" monster you control would be destroyed by a card effect each turn, it is not destroyed. During your Main Phase: You can target 1 of your "Mendiwake" cards that is banished or in your GY; send this face-up card to the GY, and if you do, add that target to your hand, then you can activate 1 "Mendiwake Anboto—Cave of Red Storms" directly from your Deck or GY. You can only use each effect of "Mendiwake Txindoki—Cave of White Mist" once per turn. You can only activate 1 "Mendiwake Txindoki—Cave of White Mist" per turn.

cards.name: Mendiwake Journey Beneath the Mountain
cards.text: Fusion Summon 1 "Mendiwake" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as material. If a face-up card in a Field Zone left the field this turn, you can also send 1 "Mendiwake" monster from your Deck to the GY as material. For the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except "Mendiwake" monsters. If this card is in your GY, except the turn it was sent there: You can banish this card; shuffle up to 3 of your "Mendiwake" cards that are banished and/or in your GY into the Deck. You can only use 1 effect of "Mendiwake Journey Beneath the Mountain" per turn, and only once that turn.

cards.name: Mendiwake Eguzkilore at the Door
cards.role: Trap access, protection and resource filtering
cards.text: When this card is activated: You can Set 1 "Mendiwake" Trap directly from your Deck. Your opponent cannot target "Mendiwake" Field Spells or Fusion Monsters you control with card effects. If a face-up card in a Field Zone leaves the field: You can draw 1 card, then discard 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Mendiwake Eguzkilore at the Door" once per turn. You can only activate 1 "Mendiwake Eguzkilore at the Door" per turn.

cards.name: Mendiwake Bell Across the Valley
cards.role: Flexible disruption and immediate Field transition
cards.text: Target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; return it to the hand, then, if you control a face-up "Mendiwake" Field Spell, send it to the GY, and if you do, you can activate 1 "Mendiwake" Field Spell with a different name directly from your Deck or GY. You can only activate 1 "Mendiwake Bell Across the Valley" per turn.

cards.name: Mendiwake Dolmen Raised Before Dawn
cards.role: Recovery, swarming and defensive Fusion setup
cards.text: Special Summon 1 "Mendiwake" monster from your hand or GY in Defense Position, then, if a face-up card in a Field Zone left the field this turn, you can Special Summon 1 "Mendiwake" monster with a different name from your hand or GY. Negate the effects of monsters Special Summoned by this effect, also they cannot attack this turn. For the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except "Mendiwake" monsters. If a Fusion Summoned "Mendiwake" monster you control is destroyed by an opponent's card: You can Set this card from your GY, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Mendiwake Dolmen Raised Before Dawn" once per turn.

cards.name: Mendiwake—The Night Belongs to Gaueko
cards.text: When this card is activated: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change it to face-down Defense Position. Monsters your opponent controls lose 300 ATK/DEF for each "Mendiwake" Field Spell with a different name in your GY. If a face-up card in a Field Zone leaves the field: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change it to face-down Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Mendiwake—The Night Belongs to Gaueko" once per turn. You can only activate 1 "Mendiwake—The Night Belongs to Gaueko" per turn.

cards.name: Mendiwake Oath of the Threshold
cards.role: Searchable archetypal omni-negate and Field transition
cards.text: When your opponent activates a card or effect, while you control a "Mendiwake" monster and a face-up "Mendiwake" Field Spell: Send that Field Spell to the GY; negate the activation, and if you do, banish that card, then you can activate 1 "Mendiwake" Field Spell with a different name directly from your Deck or GY. You can only activate 1 "Mendiwake Oath of the Threshold" per turn.
